content: E-commerce table stakes (corroborated across 5+ checklist sources, 2026): product catalog with categories + filtering/sorting; product detail page with images/description/price/stock; shopping cart with add/edit/remove and running totals; simple checkout with minimal fields; payment step; order management/tracking; customer accounts with order history. Common additions: search autocomplete, wishlist, reviews/ratings, coupons, recommendations.
